rule.statement: a figure the run never reported is recorded as 'not reported' (未报告), never as 0; a genuine reported 0 stays 0
rule.theRoundAlreadyHeldThisRule: r1-supplemental-2026-09-24/evidence/ledger.json:9 — "a figure the run never reported is recorded as 'not recorded', never as 0"
rule.howItWasViolated: the ledger's own usage block did not follow it: the recorder wrote a placeholder 0 and every reader (ledger, run-facts, run-meta, the run's console line) then printed it as a figure
rule.collapse: driver/r1-stack.ts:560 — `cacheWriteTokens: chunk.usage.cacheWriteTokens ?? 0` cannot tell 'the gateway reported 0' from 'the gateway reported nothing'
rule.whichCaseHolds: the second: 0 of the 15 durable usage objects of this run carry a cacheWriteTokens key
rule.genuineZeroStaysZero: the same objects show what a genuine reported zero looks like: cacheReadTokens is present on 15 of 15 (value 0 on 2) and reasoningTokens is present on 15 of 15 (value 0 on all 15). A field genuinely reported as 0 appears as a key with value 0; a field that was never reported does not appear at all.
rule.whyTheFieldCouldNotExistHere: the run used the chat-completions protocol, whose translate.ts maps no cache-write field at all (0 occurrences of `cacheWriteTokens`); messages/translate.ts maps cache_creation_input_tokens -> cacheWriteTokens, but that protocol was not used. The 0 is a structural fallback on every response, not a measurement.
